newsitem.title: GHANA: Shares remain weak on Ghana bourse.
newsitem.headline: Shares remain weak on Ghana bourse.

text.p: Ghanaian shares languished in negative territory on Monday, extending heavy losses seen in trading late last week.
Traders say sentiment remains negative, with two of three stocks that recorded price changes losing ground.
The GSE All-Share Index was off 0.27 points to 358.21 from Friday's 357.94 points when the index fell by 2.25 points.
Total volume on Monday was 155,070 shares, with offers far outpacing bids at 3,410,970 to 1,168,670 shares.
On the broader market, trading group Paterson Zochonis and Social Security Bank lost two cedis and 10 cedis to 368 cedis and 1,070 cedis respectively.
Guinness Ghana Ltd, the only gainer, added 10 cedis to 310 cedis.
